jobs.title: Senior Associate/Analyst- GL Accounting
jobs.description:
ISP India Private Limited 
 
 Job Description –  Sr.Associate/Analyst- GL Accounting 
 Are you the kind of person that is always thinking, sketching, seeking, and adjusting? Who needs to understand how things work and then figure out how they can work better? Are you a passionate, tenacious, solver who loves to work with others who share your drive? Are you positive, constructive, and ingenious?
 Are you always solving?
 Then we’d like to meet you and bet you’d like to meet us, Are you always solving?
 Ashland has an exciting opportunity for a GL Accounting to join our Hyderabad office. This is a very visible, significant role within the Company and the Finance division. This position will report to Sr. Manager Accounting. 
 Shift: US shift 
 Timings: ( 5 PM to 2 AM IST) 
 Roles & Responsibilities 
 The general ledger accountants responsible for compliance with US GAAP and internal reporting requirements include, but are not limited to:
 Closing Activities 
 Responsible for all accounting tasks for the nominated entities in accordance with US GAAP requirements and Ashland accounting policies
 Posting of revenue recognition related accruals, e.g., shipped not billed, Contract related, Deferred Revenue etc.
 Posting of standard entries as part of the month/quarter/year end closing
 Posting of profit center and cost center reclassifications requested by business analysts and accounting
  Perform regular checks on the hygiene of the Financial Statements (BS, P&L, Cost Center Trends etc.) and take adequate action
  Preparation of reports for analysis by controllers, SOX trends, Allocation schedules etc.
 Preparation of Balance Sheet Accounts reconciliations over Blackline
 Any ad-hoc reports to be used by the controllers for statistical and/or statutory reporting
 Posting Fiscal Stat Adjustments per Local GAAP as recommended by Local Accounting
   External / Internal Reporting 
 Preparation of Government Forms for BEA reporting (Group Task)
 Preparation of the external and internal audit documentation (reconciliation, G/L account breakdown, supporting documentation);
 Identify any Internal controls risks
 Update Tax Provision and Deferred Tax Provision along with Quarterly Forecasts on One Source
   Other Tasks 
 Ensure compliance with US GAAP / SOX
 Participate in special (ad-hoc) projects
 Liaise with other departments such as Treasury, Account Payable, etc.
 Provide adequate support for the Internal and Stat Audits
  Co-ordinate with Local Compliance partners
 Candidate Requirements 
 Hands on experience of 3-5 years in General Ledger Accounting 
 Experience working on LATAM Countries would be a plus
 Professional level of knowledge of modern accounting practices
 Understanding of US GAAP/ SOX reporting requirement
 Proficient in the use of any modern ERP tool (preferably SAP)
 Good understanding of the use and application of other I.T. (Excel, Word)
 Pro-active, hands-on mentality, convincing, motivated and team player
 Fluent in English (both verbal and written)
 Ready to work in the Night shift (5 PM to 2 AM) 
  
 
 
 In more than 100 countries, the people of Ashland LLC. (NYSE: ASH) provide the specialty chemicals, technologies and insights to help customers create new and improved products for today and sustainable solutions for tomorrow. Our chemistry is at work every day in a wide variety of markets and applications, including architectural coatings, automotive, construction, energy, personal care and pharmaceutical. Visit www.ashland.com to see the innovations we offer. At Ashland our vision is to be a leading, global specialty chemicals company whose inspired and engaged employees add value to all we touch. In fact our people, employees, customers and vendors define who we are. They are the driving force behind everything we do. Not only do we value our customers but we value our employees, and we work to offer them a dynamic and challenging environment. We hold ourselves to high standards at Ashland, and we value integrity and honesty. Ashland has a history of attracting the best people and keeping them. The reasons are simple: industry competitive salary and benefits, pay-for-performance incentive plans and a diverse work environment where employees feel challenged and valued. People come to Ashland and stay. As a growing Fortune 500 specialty chemicals company, we offer opportunities for development and advancement throughout our global organization. Our values define who we are and what we care about as a company. If you are looking for a relationship with a company instead of simply a job, this may be a great fit. 
 Ashland is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation. 
 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. NOTE: We do not accept resumes from external staffing agencies or independent recruiters for any of our openings unless we have a signed recruiting agreement in place to fill a specific position.
